messages:
anna: FYI - Zenith Retail signed a Dedicated commitment and we published their listing on AWS Marketplace this morning. Private Offer + onboarding checklist completed. :tada:

kevin: Amazing! What's the committed capacity and the headline benefit they saw?

anna: They committed 10 GPUs (reserved) with a 28% discount. Zenith reported a 3.2x throughput increase for their realtime recommendation models and noted predictable cost during Black Friday tests.

marketplace-bot: AWS Marketplace listing live (Listing ID: zenith-rw-2026). Private Offer available  PO ID: PO-AWS-778891.

sara: Legal approved the case study and the customer quote. Zenith ok'd: "Redwood made scaling inference during peak retail events painless and materially cheaper."

eng-docs: Can we get a short 3-bullet how-to for the docs on Marketplace + Dedicated onboarding? Suggest: 1) Accept Private Offer, 2) Grant Marketplace entitlements, 3) Follow Dedicated onboarding runbook. We'll draft and post by EOD.

marketing-bot: Draft assets uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/partners/zenith-retail (case-study.pdf, hero-screenshot.png, 30s demo). Draft social copy saved for review.

kevin: Can support/sre prioritize KV-cache tuning runbook for retail models? Zenith wants warmup guidance for seasonal spikes.

eng-docs: Noted  adding warmup steps and suggested batch sizes to the runbook. ETA tomorrow morning.

legal: Confirmed final quote and approved press release language. All set to publish after marketing gives the green light.

anna: Early marketplace telemetry: 21 listing views, 4 private-offer inquiries, 1 trial activation. Planning a joint webinar with Zenith ENG in two weeks.

marketing-bot: Scheduling: blog + social next Tue, console banner Wed. Assigned tasks to kevin and anna.

sara: Thanks team  great milestone for retail. If anyone needs to tweak the quote or assets, DM me. :rocket:
